This name is often used to address spiritual leaders, gurus, or those who have attained a high level of spiritual realization.
data.spiritual_significance: Paramanand is a powerful spiritual name that carries the essence of ultimate joy, peace and enlightenment. It signifies the deep longing of the soul for the highest truth, and the journey of self-realization that leads to a state of pure, unadulterated bliss. Those who bear this name are believed to be on a divine path, seeking the supreme joy and peace that comes from being one with the divine. The name Paramanand is an inspiring reminder of the ultimate goal of human existence – the attainment of the supreme joy and peace that comes from realizing our inner divine self.

historical_references.reference: Paramanand was a renowned Hindu monk and philosopher, who lived during the 14th to 15th centuries. He was a prominent figure of the Bhakti movement, which emphasized the importance of devotion to God as a means to achieve spiritual enlightenment. Paramanand is best known for his works that advocate the path of love and devotion to the deity Rama.

historical_references.reference: Paramanand was also known as Paramansham, and he was a prolific author, who wrote numerous commentaries, hymns, and philosophical treatises. Some of his most well-known works include 'Ananda Ramayana', 'Nityasukhrahasya', and 'Abhijnana Ramayana', which continue to be revered and studied by Hindus around the world.
